killedBy: createControllersPane (issue #556) removes every listener it added, on both of its own controls
why: Leaves the pane's Back listener on a disposed HUD, so a second `createHud` over the same document has two panes answering one click. `dispose` is the only place a pane may undo what its factory did, and a missed removal is invisible to every test that builds one HUD and tears it down: it survives all 341 `createHud` cases.
